holdings.name: HFCL Ltd

watch.text: Board meeting on October 28, 2026 to consider Q2 FY27 unaudited results.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 3.56% of fund assets in the 9.9% energy basket, its 8.67% 3-month decline detracted an estimated -0.309%.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carrying a 2.61% weight, its 14.0% 3-month decline subtracted an estimated -0.365% from fund returns.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.49% weight, Sun TV was among the leading contributors, returning 27.91% over 3 months and adding an estimated 0.695%.

portfolio.statement: Quant Small Cap Fund holds 87.6% in equities and 11.2% in cash and others, delivering a flat 3-month return of -0.06% against a 15.21% 6-month gain.
interp: Top contributors Welspun Corp and HFCL provided substantial gains that offset double-digit drawdowns in Adani group holdings.
The portfolio maintains high concentration in its top 10 holdings at 36.1%, led by Financials (17.4%) and Consumer Discretionary (16.4%).
portfolio.line: Gains in industrial manufacturing and technology equipment offset sharp corrections across Adani group holdings.

drivers.text: Welspun Corp generated a 62.6% 3-month return to lead fund contributions.
HFCL gained 20.1% over 3 months supported by expanding quarterly profits and data center interest.
